method: An ephemeral Node.js script imported mountVisual and all three content lesson arrays, supplied a minimal DOM shim, mounted every lesson with a visual in English and Chinese, and dispatched events on the mounted controls. The script was executed through stdin; this JSON is a result summary, not the executable harness.
checks: Node syntax validation of web/visuals.mjs passed.
All visual lessons mounted without throwing in both languages.
Range controls were exercised at their minimum, maximum and zero (with range clamping).
Every available select option was exercised.
Trace buttons were repeatedly exercised, including completed and reset states.
SVG markup contained no NaN or Infinity coordinates, and no undefined-valued attributes.
Each mounted model retained a nonempty live result after events.
Returned cleanup functions removed registered event listeners.
An unknown visual key displayed an explanatory unavailable-model fallback.
limitations: The DOM shim is not a browser. It does not verify rendered layout, fonts, SVG clipping, pixel appearance, browser accessibility-tree behavior or native WebView2 compatibility.
These are mount, event and finite-value checks, not a full independent scientific review or exhaustive numeric property test.
The script was not saved; reproduce or extend the harness before treating this summary as a repeatable automated test suite.
Browser and native visual review are separate validation layers.
